rulings.english: We settle on version D's direction. Version D's approach as a whole feels the best for now.
rulings.scope: on a loose original, where D's adaptive fill may grow a unit's size up to 1.10 to reach its frame's foot (the thesis, 2307.16209v1-zh, against B's record at 51e5ee49: size 1 -> 1.099, size spread 0 -> 0.099; no solid-set output moves)
rulings.why: The third measure that moved, frames past the right edge (0.2753 -> 0.3088 on the thesis), is the metric, not ink, and stands: 71 of the 74 new frames end in a hung CJK closing mark (half an em into the margin by rule, its ink a median 5.22 pt inside the frame's edge) and 3 are lines longer than a short original last line the measure takes as its own frame; at high resolution on pages 5, 7, 18, 20 and 27, 17 lines recorded past the edge, none with ink beyond it.
